# Balmorex Pro (balmorex.onrender.com)

> This site is an independent reader information site about Balmorex Pro, a non-greasy topical cream. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Format: topical cream in a jar marked "Relief and Recovery Cream", about 4 oz (118 mL); seller's directions: apply daily to the sore area
- Named ingredients: sunflower oil, shea butter, arnica oil, aloe vera, bromelain, magnesium sulfate, MSM, niacin, ginger root extract, menthol, hemp seed oil; no amounts given; the seller's "27-in-1" figure and a mention of frankincense are not on its list
- Packs: 1 jar $79; 3 jars $59 each ($177, free US shipping, two bonus eBooks); 6 jars $49 each ($294, free US shipping, two bonus eBooks); single jar shipping unclear
- 60-day money-back guarantee (return within 60 days, or email for a refund)
- Not a treatment for arthritis or any condition; do not use under heat or tight wraps; patch test first; check the jar for a Drug Facts panel
